notes.title: Update 4.1
notes.notes:
hello everyone, we are back again with bug fixes we have seen from people in the community, please continue to let us know your issues so we can fix them.

-Fixed a performance issue when an item gets highlighted (it will be added later in the future)
-Fixed a bug where pots would remain after a save when you delete a campfire.
-Fixed a bug with training soldier would not spawn correctly blocking the player from proceeding with the quest or leaving the area.
-Fixed the foliage removals not saving correctly.
-Reduced the size of the mouse cursor.
-Fixed some materials and floating trees/objects on the map.
-Fixed an issue with later quests not appearing after a load.
-Added markers for the NPCs once you enter the village.
-Fixed an issue where Sticks would drop under the map.

also, update 5 is already in the works and it will focus on returning the item highlighter in addition to focusing on more performance gains.

notes.title: Update 4
notes.notes:
hello everyone, this update focused mainly on quality of life things like the following: 

1) making the map more beautiful (better textures).
2) boosting the performance of this map. 
3) Increased the spawn rate of rabbits.
4) night now is not as dark as it was.
5) slowed down the weather until the main quest is done.

hope everyone enjoys!

notes.title: Update 3
notes.notes:
Finally done with patch/update 3!

alot of changes were made in this update so your old saves will not work anymore, please start over with a new save file. if you face any crashes, please delete this folder in the following path in your pc.

C:\Users\{user name here}\AppData\Local\SurviveTheWinter

aside of that, the minimum requirements were changes to follow up with the changes made to the game.

Changes Made:

1) Map Rework, added a lot of straight areas to help with building, changes made to the village, campfire added across the map, fields and many more.
2) Complete Quest Rework, added new quests with voice lines to make it interesting.
3) added markers to the quest to help show the player where to go during the quest.
4) Loot system was also added to areas across the map.
5) New Planting system was added.
6) New Seed Merchant Added to the village.
6) New animals were added including boars, crabs, squirrels and crocodiles.
7) New Boss was added to enemy campfire.
8) adjusted night darkness to help with visibility.

Please Let us know how the update is for you and we wish everyone a happy new year!

notes.title: Update 2
notes.notes:
More Fixes and Additions this time.

NEW:

-Map Markers that will help you find specific animals you are looking for, can be viewed by simply opening the map
-Flat Roof Addition
-Railings can now be built on ceilings

FIXES:
-More Precise Map Location to know exactly where you are in the map
-More & bigger Spawners so you can find the animals you want
-Better Building LODs for those running on DX11 
-Fixed an issue with animals dropping from sky on some occasions
-Fixed & Changed some torches that bug out on load
-Fixed a Bug Where the boss in the red area would have his sword floating sometimes
-Better Performance overall

Our New goal is to focus more on the NPCs in the village as as focusing on the questing to make it easier & more enjoyable overall. Just Like Last time, we thank you for your suggestions and bug reporting, if you have more things in mind you want us to add or any bugs that need fixing, kindly please let us know.

notes.title: Update 1
notes.notes:
First Update Since the game was published, horary! Thanks for everyone for reporting what they encountered, this update will bring a new building feature + some fixes.

Patch Notes:

NEW:

-Corner Roof Added, Both Wood & Rock

FIXES:

-Fixed a Bug With "L Shaped Railings" not always put in the right place
-Fixed Fire Torch Interaction from a very long range
-Fixed Sound Looping Issue Near The Beach
-Fixed a cut through the sea planes in an area in the map
-Fixed Some Issues with Mesh Clipping For NPCs
-Fixed Multiple floating Meshes in the map
-Fixed an Issue with Map That causes a hitch in some areas

Thank You For Reporting the issues again and helping us update this even further.
